_hub_doc: Entities every event shares; they never join events into one story. Hosts compare case-insensitively without the domain.
_suppress_doc: Known false positives dropped before grouping. Keys in an entry must all match: rule, desc_regex, ip_regex.

suppress._why: Sigma public-IP logon rules fired on the LAN's own GUAs before sigma2wazuh local_filters went in (v7, 2026-11-24 06:13 UTC)

_overrides_doc: Per-rule level/technique overrides for scoring only. Wazuh tags 87702 (pfSense block burst) T1110, which turns every blocked burst into Credential Access.
_blocked_doc: Events that show a failed attempt. A story made only of them is capped at medium (all_blocked).
